entities.name: user
entities.summary: Began as Junior Data Analyst at Bridgemark Solutions on January 15th, a mid-size consulting firm with 200 employees located on SW 5th Avenue in downtown Portland. Title was restructured in February to Data Analyst, with no junior or senior labels. Around late February, transitioned from the general analytics pool to a dedicated client project for MedVantage, a healthcare company. On March 3rd, assigned ownership of the quarterly reporting deliverable for MedVantage by manager Diane Kowalski, who leads the analytics team and has been with the company for seven years. Prefers independent problem-solving over large group settings.
